labels.text: section 4940(a): 1.39 percent flat rate on the net investment income of an exempt private foundation

1.39 percent — the current pinned text of section 4940(a), enacted as a single flat rate (replacing the former two-tier 1%/2% structure) by the Taxpayer Certainty and Disaster Tax Relief Act of 2019 (Pub. L. 116-94, division Q, section 206), applicable to taxable years beginning after December 20, 2019. This package's pinned notes for section 4940 were not individually checked against this exact enactment date at coverage-start precision — flagged as an unverified boundary, not an invented rate; the RATE ITSELF (1.39 percent) is the pinned current text.
